scope: Freeze evaluation before further inline formula/code/context method selection. No weight fine-tuning, new inference, production gate, or Canonical Acceptance in this step.

split_policy.unit: Whole original document work and all linked derivatives; merge ancestry components before splitting
split_policy.holdout_claim: Not used for this experiment method selection; not a model-pretraining contamination attestation or representative production sample
split_policy.validation_plan: Development plus its fixed regressions selects at most one challenger; the fresh pool is used once for paired confirmation. No clean validation score currently exists; if more model/threshold search is needed, acquire separate group-disjoint validation data before searching.

development_search.budget_unit: At most3 new complete configurations in the next development cycle; all earlier trials remain disclosed
development_search.stop_rule: Stop after3 configurations or after fixed source-quality and regression requirements are satisfied. If none qualify, report no selected challenger; do not expand search based on holdout.
selection_order: Existing source-quality and positive/negative regression gates
Per-document and per-task faithful delivery, material errors and missing work together; do not trade a material subgroup regression for pooled improvement
Latency/cost only among candidates satisfying the same quality requirements
development_search.future_cv: Grouped/nested evaluation only if evaluating a larger search procedure with enough independent data; known-case folds here cannot erase prior exposure.

scoring_scope: V12 inline math and prose reinsertion
Collateral F01/F02/F18/F21 on scored pages; other V01-V19 stay retained regression scope
source_annotation.page_rule: After PDF page count is obtained by an independent curator: include first and last physical pages, then up to2 remaining pages with lowest SHA256(utf8(document_sha256 + colon + one_based_page_number)); deduplicate and sort. No outcome-dependent page replacement.
source_annotation.context_rule: Both methods receive the same selected full pages and immediate preceding/following pages when available; score all relevant source units on selected pages, with boundary continuations accounted once. Context-only pages cannot satisfy target-source coverage.
source_annotation.units: Source-only curator inventories every prose/math/code opportunity and no-math/no-code negative region on scored pages, before candidate outputs; preserve physical page and exact scope; denominator never derives only from emitted items.
source_annotation.ambiguity: Source ambiguity fixed before seeing outputs, recorded separately and never counted as correct; model uncertainty on a clear source is abstention, not source ambiguity. Missing sources stay named availability failures.
source_annotation.coverage_gap: If sampled sources/pages lack required subtypes, report not evaluated; do not choose replacements based on candidate outcomes. Any source-only coverage expansion gets a new pre-output manifest.

scoring.eligible_denominator: All frozen, source-clear required opportunities, including missing model outputs; true no-content negatives and source-ambiguous units reported separately
scoring.selective_error: accepted outputs failing their fixed source rubric / accepted; undefined when accepted=0
scoring.faithful_delivery: accepted outputs passing their fixed source rubric / eligible
scoring.false_abstention: abstained source-positive eligible opportunities / source-positive eligible opportunities
scoring.technical_failure_rate: Eligible opportunities affected by execution failure / eligible; report failed attempts separately, never divide request count by source-opportunity count
scoring.negative_control_failure: unsupported accepted outputs / fixed negative-control cases
scoring.document_macro: Mean per-document faithful delivery for documents with eligible opportunities; report each distinct document and missing task strata; no crop independence assumption
reporting: Accepted minor differences separately from material errors
Paired baseline-to-challenger new regressions and recoveries
Client timing/component/end-to-end scope, cost and failures separately
scoring.zero_denominator: null / not evaluated, never zero error or perfect success
scoring.severity: Reuse confirmed case-specific requirements and allowed equivalence/minor differences. The ordinary-prose OpenAI/OpenAl clarification is not a blanket relaxation of code/math/numbers. Complex-table tolerance remains in its original task scope.
scoring.statistical_claim: Six purposively selected works are a bounded pilot, not statistical generalization. No pooled crop-level confidence interval; any future interval must state group sampling and dependence assumptions.
scoring.accepted_meaning: Delivered by the evaluated method for use, not Canonical Acceptance. One adjudicated outcome per frozen source opportunity, not a count of model blocks.
scoring.source_unit_and_matching: Curator freezes non-overlapping paragraph/display-formula/code-block source opportunities and their obligations. Mixed inline math/code is nested in its paragraph, not an extra aggregate unit. Evaluator matches all emitted spans using available source evidence; duplicate output makes the matching source unit fail. Unmatched additions are separately counted and block adoption. Task slices may overlap and must not be summed as independent trials.
scoring.partition_rule: Each eligible opportunity has exactly one outcome; no output means named not-attempted/missing unless an attributable failure applies. Source ambiguity and true negative no-content are separate fixed inventories. Crashes and missing outputs never disappear from eligible.
scoring.unmatched_additions: Count every unsupported emitted addition separately; do not enlarge the source denominator or let high faithful-delivery mask extra claims.

paired_run.baseline: Frozen starting provider/method actually used for the comparison, with exact version/config/dependencies; not a fabricated cumulative best-of-past output
paired_run.infrastructure_failure: Preserve failed attempt; any predeclared recovery is separately attributable and not silently substituted. No retries or requests in this freeze step.
holdout_unlock_requires: Frozen source-only inventory/oracle and page manifest
Frozen baseline and single challenger locks
No exposure conflict or unresolved ancestry
Identical supported input scope for both methods
paired_run.outcome_feedback: Once holdout results are inspected, record consumption. Any method change motivated by results makes that batch exposed for the next selection cycle; keep its result and obtain a new untouched batch. No reshuffle or successful-run selection.

limits: Holdout custody is not annotated capability coverage or model validation
Logical evaluator/method separation only; repository access is not a security sandbox
No local GPU/company serving/high-frequency SLO verification
Original requirements remain unchanged; Canonical Acceptance requires later complete integration evidence
